title: schefflera lucescens var. rigida
intro: Schefflera lucescens var. rigida, commonly known as the "Upright Schefflera" or "Variegated Schefflera," is a plant species within the family Araliaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
